verdict.rationale: New Relic documents collecting logs alongside application and infrastructure telemetry in one platform. APM agents add metadata to logs to give 'logs in context' across the platform, and the log docs describe visibility into events, errors and traces, which covers the logs-to-APM pivot. A community user values 'having everything in one dashboard.' Explicit trace collection and pivots between metrics and traces are only implied, and one user reports the logging agent losing logs for months, so this is partial rather than full. Missing for 10: documented distributed-trace collection, an explicit metrics↔traces↔logs correlation workflow (e.g. trace ID linking from traces to logs and back), and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-signal pivoting.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can collect metrics, logs, and traces in one platform and pivot between them with shared context
